WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT
    o.recordvault AS ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    timespan,
    avg_fill,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY timespan
      ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS fill_rank,
    AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS timespan_avg_fill
  FROM order_fills
)
SELECT
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  avg_fill - timespan_avg_fill AS above_timespan_avg,
  fill_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE avg_fill > timespan_avg_fill
  AND fill_rank <= 3;
